definitions.explanation: A statement of disagreement or opposition.
Something that is different or unusual.

examples.japanese: {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧。
{異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no room for objection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧。
⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{異|い} has two main uses: as a noun meaning "objection" and as a prefix/modifier meaning "different" or "unusual." It appears frequently in formal and literary contexts.

AS "OBJECTION":
- {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to raise an objection
- {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧: to interject an objection
- {異|い}⟦なし→無し：03779_nashi⟧: no objection (formal)
- {異|い}⟦{存|ぞん}→存：noentry⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no objection (formal/humble)

AS "DIFFERENT/UNUSUAL" (prefix in compounds):
- ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧: abnormal
- ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧: personnel transfer
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧: objection, protest
- ⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧: foreign country
- ⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧: different culture

USAGE:
⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧ is a literary/formal equivalent of ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ (different). It appears in written language: ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (a different culture).
